Mistral Large 4 (API id mistral-large-4) launched 2026-10-06 as a Public Preview. Read 2026-10-07 on two first-party surfaces that agree: the pricing table at docs.mistral.ai/inference/pricing (Standard tier, regional inference off) and the model card at docs.mistral.ai/models/mistral-large-4-0. Both show a SALE: list price $1.36 input / $0.14 cached input / $4.18 output per MTok struck through, sale price $0.68 / $0.07 / $2.09. This record publishes the sale price because that is what Mistral charges today. Neither page states when the sale ends, and the 2026-10-06 announcement post lists only the $1.36 / $4.18 list price; the schema cannot carry a scheduled reversion, so the list price lives only in this note. effective_from is our observation date, not a claimed change date. No aggregator listed it at read time, which is why the automated cross-check could not corroborate it.
